description: This file defines the class QueryParamBuilder responsible for serializing AWS API shapes into query parameters, supporting structures, lists, maps, and primitive types.

classes.name: QueryParamBuilder
classes.description: A class for building query parameters from AWS API shape objects, used internally for request serialization.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Determines the query parameter name for a given shape based on its 'queryName' or 'locationName' properties.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if a shape is flattened based on its 'flattened' property.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a StructureShape into an array of query parameters.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Dispatches the formatting of a shape's value into the query array based on its type.

methods.name: format_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structured shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into query parameters.

methods.name: format_blob
methods.description: Encodes binary data as base64 for inclusion in query parameters.

methods.name: format_timestamp
methods.description: Formats timestamp shape values into a specified string format, defaulting to ISO8601.

methods.name: format_boolean
methods.description: Serializes boolean values into 'true' or 'false' strings.
